  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR introduces a CI failure in `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` because the combined size of the custom instruction files (`AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`) exceeds the Copilot reviewer's limit for custom instructions.
  WHY: The job fails with `custom_instructions_too_large` (HTTP 422), which blocks CI and stops the Copilot reviewer from working; the source labelled it MAJOR (mapped to high). Other reviewers (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3) judged this external and unrelated to the diff, so they disagree on whether it is a defect of this PR.
